Possible remedies include increasing limits, optimizing memory, investigating leaks, and reducing workload size.
Readiness determines whether an instance should receive production traffic.

Liveness determines whether the process is functioning and whether restart may be appropriate.

Test service DNS inside a Pod with `nslookup <service-name>`.
